model: IsolationForest(n_estimators=200) + robust z-score guard, trained on pre-injection baseline
insights: User impact detected: SLO was breached for 95s; availability during the fault was 13.5% (lowest 0.0%).

Latency degradation: p95 reached 1.95s. Recommendation: client timeouts + retries to healthy replicas, and horizontal autoscaling.
